reuse.why: Fintegra uses the existing linkBankSyncAccount and bank-selection helpers, and local unlinking is extracted for reuse, although transaction downloading repeats existing logic.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions duplicates Akahu's authentication, request, error handling and response normalization instead of sharing that workflow.

placement.why: Link policies, transaction downloading, endpoint configuration and provider types remain in their established modules.

scope.why: All edits directly support the requested linking rules, replacement option and Fintegra integration.

maintainability.why: Centralized linking policies and shared unlink cleanup are straightforward to maintain, but another copied downloader increases the cost of future transport changes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All provider link handlers use linkBankSyncAccount, and both unlinking paths use clearAccountBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: In accounts/sync.ts, downloadFintegraTransactions repeats downloadAkahuTransactions with provider names changed and the response variable initialization slightly reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gains replaceExistingLink and branches for closed targets, duplicate-link refusal and clearing the previous holder; all provider callers continue through the helper.
